'''Torva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who studied to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Forceful]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Torva and her sister, [[Morana/Legends|Morana]], had a falling out when Morana began a life of crime. Torva began training in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in hopes of becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], wielding a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]] with a blue crystal at its core. Alongside [[Gerant/Legends|Gerant]], Torva traveled to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] within a mountain peak. Entering the cave alone, Torva used her lightsaber for light, defending herself against feral men that leaped to attack her. Finding an amphitheater at the heart of the mountain, Torva recognized her sister standing alongside a man, a woman, and a child chained to posts at the center of the room. Vowing to save her sister, Torva engaged Morana in a brief [[Duel (short story)|duel]], knocking aside Morana's [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] with her lightsaber. When Morana disengaged and attempted to execute the captives, Torva speared her sister through with her lightsaber pike. As the apparition of Morana faded away to nothing, Torva exited the cave, having successfully moved closer to becoming a Jedi.<ref name="NoP" />
